_comment: Factions and politics: navies, governors, commissions, pardons, the Brethren. See docs/events.md.

navy_inspection.title: Show your commission
navy_inspection.text: A {nation_adj} frigate runs alongside. Her captain demands to see your letter of marque, and looks ready to take your ship if it isn't in order.

choices.result: He reads it twice, hands it back, and wishes you good hunting.
choices.fail_result: He keeps you hove to for a day out of spite before letting you go.

choices.text: Refuse: you answer to your own Admiralty
choices.result: He fumes, but he has no right to stop you.

governor_loan.title: The governor's request
governor_loan.text: The governor of {port} asks, very politely, for a loan of 300 gold to repair the fortifications. Repayment is... uncertain.

choices.result: He clasps your hand. You'll be welcome here for years.
He's grateful, if a little disappointed.
He commiserates. Hard times for everyone.
choices.fail_result: He knows exactly how much you have.

privateers_wanted.title: Privateers wanted
privateers_wanted.text: Handbills on every quay in {port}: the governor seeks captains to sail against {enemy}. Letters of marque are to be had at the governor's house.

choices.result: He'll see you in the Governor's tab. Your name is already on his desk.
There's money in war, but there's also a rope for anyone who gets it wrong.

pardon_debate.title: The pardon
pardon_debate.text: The King's Pardon is the only thing the crew talk about. {wants} wants to take it and go home to family. {against} says any man who takes it is no better than a hangman.

choices.text: We'll take it, at the next English port
choices.result: Half the crew cheer. The other half go very quiet.

choices.text: We're Brethren, and we'll die Brethren
choices.result: The black flag stays up. {wants} looks out at the sea for a long time.

choices.text: Every man may choose for himself
choices.result: {wants} and a few others go ashore at the next landfall to seek the pardon.

enemy_spy.title: An offer from the other side
enemy_spy.text: A {enemy_adj} agent finds you in a back room in {port}. He'll pay well for a count of the guns in the fort and the ships in harbour.

choices.text: Take his money and count the guns
choices.result: Easy money. Nobody saw a thing.
choices.fail_result: You're seen sketching the bastions. You leave with his money and a price on your head here.

choices.text: Turn him in to the governor
choices.result: He hangs the following week. The governor is very grateful.

choices.text: Refuse, and forget you met him
choices.result: He bows and melts away.

navy_deserter_asks.title: A deserter
navy_deserter_asks.text: A man swims out to your ship at night: a {nation_adj} navy topman, flogged one time too many, who begs to sign on.

choices.result: {topman} is a fine seaman. The navy will be looking.
The crew watch {topman} rowed away in irons.
{topman} swims for another ship.

enemy_privateer.title: Enemy privateer
enemy_privateer.text: A {enemy_adj} privateer, flying a commission against your nation, comes about to engage.

choices.result: Guns run out on both sides.
Every sail you have.

admiralty_commendation.title: A letter from the Admiralty
admiralty_commendation.text: A packet boat brings a letter sealed with the Admiralty's arms. Your service has been noted.

choices.result: A purse of a hundred guineas and the thanks of the Crown. The men stand a little taller.

brethren_council.title: A raid with the Brethren
brethren_council.text: The pirate captains in {port} are meeting in the old fort. They're planning a joint raid on a {nation_adj} convoy and want your ship.

choices.result: You'll sail with the others in three days.

choices.text: Speak for a bigger share for your crew
choices.result: The council grumble, but agree.
choices.fail_result: They laugh you out of the room.

choices.result: Some of them won't forget it.

brethren_raid.title: The convoy
brethren_raid.text: Five pirate sloops fall on the {nation_adj} convoy at dawn. A merchantman breaks away to the south, and she's yours if you want her.

choices.result: She's slow, and frightened.

choices.text: Take a share of the spoils instead
choices.result: The fleet takes three ships. Your share comes to 250.

corrupt_official.title: The customs collector
corrupt_official.text: The collector of {port} hints that your ship's papers have 'irregularities', which could be smoothed over with a gift.

choices.result: {collector} smiles. Your papers are in perfect order.
{collector} decides your papers are fine after all.
choices.fail_result: {collector} finds a real irregularity and fines you for it.

fort_salute.title: The salute
fort_salute.text: The fort at {port} fires a salute as you come in. Custom demands you answer gun for gun.

choices.result: Nine guns, smartly fired. The garrison approve.
Someone in the fort takes it as an insult.
